scope: Five individually verified stranded members. Three enclosing archives retain the supplied confirmed-malware status; they were rescanned, not rejudged. No sample was executed.

members.marker_note: parser-session writer: exports env and evals server reply; rules bound
execution_trace: Module load imports os and ../package.json, then snapshots process.env, subModuleVersion, OS platform, hostname, username, and noninternal IPv4-interface MAC addresses.
g replaces each pair of hex digits with String.fromCharCode(parseInt(pair,16)); the table decodes to require, axios, post, an HTTPS URL, headers, x-secret-header, secret, then.

The exported function ignores its arguments, invokes axios.post(endpoint,data,{headers:{x-secret-header:secret}}), and passes the same promise callback parameter data member to direct eval. Rejection is swallowed.
The decoded endpoint is https://log-server-lovat.vercel.app/api/ipcheck/703. No request to it or sample execution was performed.

The metadata require resolves to absent src/package.json in this extraction. src/index.js also references an absent .pnpm/httpreslog path instead of this local writer. The exact supplied package therefore does not establish successful activation.

The explicit concealed environment-export and remote-source-evaluation implementation tips the individual judgement despite broken packaging; it implements neither session parsing nor ordinary logging.

members.marker_note: osinthell p.js: empties regular files across C/D/E/F drive roots
execution_trace: Exports a function that enumerates the roots C:, D:, E:, F:, joins each root with each immediate directory entry, checks statSync(full).isFile(), then writeFileSync(full,'') with the same path.
Default write mode truncates existing regular files. This does not recurse into subdirectories, wipe disks, or perform secure erasure. Nested empty catches discard errors.
index.js imports the member and invokes p() from exported sorgu(userId), among unrelated destructive modules. Import alone only installs the exported function.

Unrestricted destruction of arbitrary drive-root contents, without a maintenance operation or selected input, establishes malicious intent. Actual invocation, drive availability, and access rights are unknown.

members.marker_note: osinthell v.js: forced recursive deletion of System32 DLLs
execution_trace: Exports a function that execSyncs del /F /S /Q C:\Windows\System32\*.dll with shell:true and stdio:ignore; a catch discards failures.
This requests forced, recursive, quiet bulk deletion of Windows system DLLs. Successful deletion is not established and depends on privileges/protection.
index.js invokes v() from sorgu(userId). Its OSINT-style wrapper neither accepts a maintenance image nor explains the destructive system target.
The hardcoded system destruction and concealed errors tip the verdict. Shared detection remains suspicious because other deployments can legitimately modify offline Windows images.

members.marker_note: osinthell t.js: disables recovery and ignores default boot failures
execution_trace: Exports a function executing bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures, followed by bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No, with shell:true and stdio:ignore.
Both calls share a try block: failure of the first skips the second. The catch suppresses exceptions. No privilege elevation is implemented.
index.js invokes t() from sorgu(userId). Silently impairing default-boot failure handling and recovery in an unrelated OSINT utility tips the malicious verdict.
Administrative recovery policy changes remain plausible in other software, so both accurate general command-text detections remain suspicious. Invocation and privileges are unknown.

members.marker_note: zlibxjson main: hidden Discord EXE download and execution
execution_trace: The installed console script zlibxjson_command calls main.init; ordinary import only exports init through __init__.py.
init obtains APPDATA; if set, download_file streams a hardcoded Discord attachment through requests.get to a filename derived from the URL with the query stripped.
The returned saved path is passed to run_silently, which Popen-launches that same path with CREATE_NO_WINDOW and shell=True. Errors are printed; absent APPDATA prints a message.

The URL names MinGCC-x64.exe. No compression or JSON functionality, normal installer workflow, integrity check, or visible user decision is implemented. Hidden executable delivery is the program's entire purpose.

The executable bytes, URL validity, successful execution, operator history and downstream behavior are unknown; no persistence or credential theft is inferred. The narrow generic deployment detections appropriately remain suspicious.

rule_corrections.correction: Resolve the actual hex decoder and table/API indexes, and bind the const environment-spread object to the Axios POST second argument. Source-to-send belongs under stealer/env. A parsed decoder corroborates the structural chain. Do not claim the environment actually contains credentials.

rule_corrections.unsupported_claim: Computed require, an encoded URL, and an arbitrary property eval in one file do not establish evaluation of the HTTP response.
rule_corrections.correction: Resolve the decoder and Axios table indexes; bind the request promise callback parameter to eval(parameter.data). This is payload activation, not a reusable command channel. GET and POST variants are supported.
